verdict.rationale: Intuit maintains official SDKs on GitHub (Node.js OAuth client, PHP V3 SDK) with documented OAuth 2.0 flow and CRUD examples, giving developers a concrete, first-party SDK to build against. Missing for 10: broader language SDK coverage (e.g., Java, .NET, Ruby), independent hands-on developer corroboration, and up-to-date OpenAPI/spec discoverability (openapi.json/llms.txt probes returned 404).
